scope: Author paraphrases of inspected research content; these objects are NOT graph Evidence objects. They do not license use of prose paraphrases as source_assertion.

facts.claim: The cloned galA locus was 1263 bp and encoded a 420-residue protein, correcting an 80-residue-short PP2518 annotation.
facts.source_locator: Results, cloning/expression, p.35384-35385; methods transcript L968-L1020
facts.qualification: Current ENA AAN68130.2 agrees in length and N-terminal sequence. Q88JX5 is a different 340-residue sequence and cannot stand for the tested full-length enzyme.

facts.claim: The PCR insert from KT2440 genomic DNA was cloned through pGEM-T Easy into NdeI/EcoRI-cut pET-29a(+), producing pETGalA under T7lac control. The reverse primer was reported 100 bp beyond the native stop.
facts.source_locator: Experimental Procedures, overproduction, p.35383; methods transcript L512-L532
facts.qualification: This supports the named construct and argues against a deliberate C-terminal fusion; no complete plasmid sequence was obtained here. Do not assert a fully sequenced tag-free recombinant product.

facts.claim: E. coli BL21(DE3) carried pETGalA; the Figure 1 caption gives BL21(DE3), while body/table transcription gives BLB21(DE3).
facts.source_locator: Figure 1 caption, p.35385; rest1 transcript L1199-L1210; methods L534-L567
facts.conditions: Induced at OD600 0.5 with 0.1 mM IPTG for 3 h.
facts.qualification: Host spelling is reconciled from the paper caption, not silently repaired inside a quotation.

facts.claim: Edman sequencing gave ARIIGG, consistent with apparent removal of the initiator methionine. A 419-residue processed chain follows from the 420-residue encoded chain.
facts.source_locator: Results, cloning/expression, p.35385; methods transcript L1005-L1020
facts.qualification: The source calls processing apparent. This is not an issued 419-residue protein accession or evidence of other terminal modifications.

facts.claim: Purification used ultracentrifugation and phenyl-Sepharose. Table 1 gives 42.7 micromol/min/mg in the final fraction, 61% yield and twofold purification.
facts.source_locator: Table 1, p.35385; rest1 transcript L1212-L1233; methods L569-L603
facts.conditions: Extraction included 50 mM MOPS pH 8, 10% glycerol, 0.2 mM ferrous ammonium sulfate and 2 mM L-cysteine; purification at 4 C.
facts.disposition: Table cells support structured primary evidence; extraction conditions remain prose-located facts.

facts.claim: Standard activity assays measured substrate-dependent oxygen use; purified preparation and crude extracts were separately specified.
facts.source_locator: Experimental Procedures, activity assays, p.35384; methods transcript L676-L719
facts.conditions: 1 ml, 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.0, 30 C, 15 microg purified protein or 20 microg crude extract, 250 microM aromatic substrate.
facts.qualification: Do not transfer substrate-screen negatives to other pH, concentrations, hosts or enzymes.

facts.claim: Gallate-dependent crude-extract oxygen use was 19.1 micromol/min/mg; vector-control extracts lacked this activity. Absorbance-based gallate loss was 19.2 micromol/min/mg.
facts.source_locator: Results, cloning/expression, p.35385; methods transcript L1022-L1085
facts.qualification: These crude-extract values differ from the purification table and the fitted Vmax.

facts.claim: In the crude-extract screen, protocatechuate, catechol, resorcinolate, resorcinol, gentisate, hydroquinone, pyrogallol, methyl gallate and syringate did not produce oxygen consumption.
facts.source_locator: Experimental Procedures L699-L703; Results L1028-L1054
facts.conditions: Standard assay F06; purified enzyme subsequently showed oxygen use only with gallate in the reported screen.
facts.qualification: No measured activity under these conditions; not proof of universal non-substrate status and not inhibition.

facts.claim: Gallate additions of 50, 100 and 250 nmol consumed 49, 99 and 244 nmol O2, respectively.
facts.source_locator: Results, cloning/expression, p.35385; methods transcript L1056-L1066
facts.qualification: Supports approximately one O2 per gallate in the tested assay; complete reaction charge/proton accounting belongs to independently reconciled native/Rhea chemistry.

facts.claim: The NMR product analysis was consistent with OMA, but the authors described keto/enol alternatives and stated that their D2O preparation gave a single peak despite those alternatives.
facts.source_locator: Results, product identification, p.35385-35386; rest1 transcript L1118-L1188; Figure 2 caption L1408-L1427
facts.conditions: Product reaction: 5 ml, 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 7, 100 microg enzyme, 2 mM gallate, 30 C for 1 h with shaking; NMR in D2O at 298 K, pH 8 or 3.
facts.qualification: The 2005 read alone does not establish immediate keto-only OMA formation or a complete absolute alkene assignment. Figure 2 pixels remain inaccessible in this package.

facts.claim: Mass spectra showed an OMA-assigned ion at m/z 201 and a PDC-assigned ion at 183. NMR lacked the predicted PDC signals, so the authors favored PDC formation during electrospray.
facts.source_locator: Results, product identification, p.35386; rest1 transcript L1240-L1261; Figure 3 and caption p.35387 L1547-L1550
facts.qualification: Do not create a physiological GalA-to-PDC edge; decarboxylated ions 157.1 and 139 were likewise analysis-associated products.

facts.claim: Purified enzyme had reported optimal pH 7, activity over pH 6-9, and optimal temperature around 30 C; Km was 144 microM and Vmax 53.2 micromol/min/mg.
facts.source_locator: Results, characterization, p.35386; rest1 transcript L1262-L1299
facts.conditions: Gallate kinetics: 0.0005-5 mM; 10 points; 3 independent experiments; source reports SD below 10%.
facts.qualification: The table specific activity 42.7 is not Vmax. pH/temperature optima are assay-specific.

facts.claim: High protocatechuate concentrations did not inhibit gallate cleavage in the purified-enzyme assay.
facts.source_locator: Results, characterization, p.35386; rest1 transcript L1262-L1270
facts.qualification: No numerical concentration or inhibition curve supplied; source marks data not shown. Do not encode PCA inhibition or infer a demonstrated binding mechanism.

facts.claim: Purified enzyme absorption was maximal at 280 nm; no long-wavelength band characteristic of the listed iron-sulfur, flavin or heme cofactors was observed.
facts.source_locator: Results, characterization, p.35386; rest1 transcript L1301-L1322
facts.qualification: Spectral non-observation is not a general proof that all other cofactors are absent.

facts.claim: Chelator and peroxide experiments preincubated purified enzyme before starting the gallate reaction.
facts.source_locator: Experimental Procedures, activity assays, p.35384; methods transcript L749-L765
facts.conditions: Enzyme 1 mg/ml; 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.0; 30 min at 4 C; reaction initiated with 250 microM gallic acid.
facts.qualification: Treat these as preparation-dependent inhibition/damage assays, not constitutive physiological regulation.

facts.claim: EDTA at 1 mM reduced activity to less than 1% of untreated enzyme.
facts.source_locator: Results, cofactor analysis, p.35386; rest1 transcript L1324-L1329; pretreatment methods L749-L765
facts.qualification: Chelator action; less than 1%, not a measured exact zero.

facts.claim: 2,2-prime-dipyridyl at 2 mM abolished detectable activity.
facts.source_locator: Results, cofactor analysis, p.35386; rest1 transcript L1329-L1339; pretreatment methods L749-L765
facts.qualification: Conditional complete loss in the reported assay; no detection threshold supplied.

facts.claim: Reactivation added metal salts at 2 mM to EDTA- or dipyridyl-treated enzyme, then incubated for another 30 min at 4 C before adding gallate.
facts.source_locator: Experimental Procedures, activity assays, p.35384; methods transcript L767-L814
facts.conditions: Salts: FeSO4, MgCl2, MnSO4, ZnCl2, CoCl2, CuCl2, NiCl2, or ferric citrate; gallate 250 microM.
facts.qualification: Results aggregate the two chelator preparations; do not invent separate per-chelator recovery values or claim removal of chelator before rescue.

facts.claim: Fe2+ was the only tested metal reported to restore full activity after chelation.
facts.source_locator: Results, cofactor analysis, p.35386; rest1 transcript L1339-L1381
facts.qualification: Native ENZRXN-18371 independently records Fe2+ as cofactor. The assay does not directly measure iron occupancy or prove a fixed stoichiometry.

facts.claim: Mn2+ restored 8% of untreated-enzyme activity after chelation.
facts.source_locator: Results, cofactor analysis, p.35386; rest1 transcript L1383-L1396
facts.qualification: Weak conditional reactivation, not evidence for Mn2+ as the physiological main cofactor.

facts.claim: Cu2+ restored 9% of untreated-enzyme activity after chelation.
facts.source_locator: Results, cofactor analysis, p.35386; rest1 transcript L1383-L1396
facts.qualification: Weak conditional reactivation; do not assign a preferred/native Cu cofactor.

facts.claim: Co2+ restored 5% of untreated-enzyme activity after chelation.
facts.source_locator: Results, cofactor analysis, p.35386; rest1 transcript L1383-L1396
facts.qualification: Weak conditional reactivation; distinguish from 2016 GalB cobalt experiments.

facts.claim: Fe3+, Mg2+, Zn2+ and Ni2+ were included in the metal rescue panel, but only Fe2+ fully restored activity and numeric results for these four ions were not stated.
facts.source_locator: Methods L767-L800; Results L1339-L1381
facts.qualification: Do not turn absence of reported numeric recovery into 0%, inhibition, or a proven lack of all reactivation.

facts.claim: Hydrogen peroxide at 1 mM left 15% of untreated activity.
facts.source_locator: Results, cofactor analysis, p.35386; rest1 transcript L1396-L1402; pretreatment methods L749-L765
facts.qualification: Oxidative-treatment result; not proof of a physiological inhibitory interaction.

facts.claim: Adding 10 mM sodium ascorbate after peroxide treatment restored activity to 50% of the untreated value.
facts.source_locator: Results, cofactor analysis, p.35386; rest1 transcript L1400-L1406; methods L800-L814
facts.conditions: After peroxide pretreatment, another 30 min at 4 C before 250 microM gallate.
facts.qualification: Partial rescue of oxidized preparation; not complete recovery or activation of untreated enzyme. Methods specify sodium ascorbate; do not silently map to neutral ascorbic acid.

facts.claim: The main sedimenting species represented about 75% of loaded protein, had s20,w 7.29 +/- 0.10 S and an equilibrium mass of 132000 +/- 12000 Da. With a calculated monomer mass of 47644 Da this was consistent with a globular homotrimer.
facts.source_locator: Results, assembly, p.35386; rest1/rest2 transcript L1446-L1466
facts.conditions: Purified enzyme in extraction buffer; sedimentation velocity at 40000 rpm and 20 C; equilibrium at 10000/13000 rpm.
facts.qualification: Supports a predominant trimer under these preparation conditions, not a uniformly trimeric population or directly measured exact subunit mass.

facts.claim: The N-terminal 1-281 and C-terminal 294-420 regions showed similarity to LigB and LigA, with a 282-293 linker. Proposed iron ligands and catalytic residues were obtained from a homology model.
facts.source_locator: Results, subgroup/model, p.35387-35389; rest2 transcript L1485-L1687; Figure 4 caption
facts.qualification: Residues His12/His59/Glu240 and catalytic His193 were predictions, not newly measured coordination or mutational causal evidence. Do not create free amino-acid nodes or transfer LigAB chemistry to GalA.

facts.claim: The phylogenetic analysis suggested a distinct GalA subgroup and possible fusion ancestry; activities of homologs were proposed from sequence, not experimentally measured here.
facts.source_locator: Results, subgroup, p.35389; rest2 transcript L1689-L1798; Figure 5 caption
facts.qualification: No experimental GalA assertion for other taxa can be inherited from this tree.

facts.claim: In citrate-grown KT2440, gallate induced galA transcript in the tested aromatic panel; syringate, protocatechuate, phloroglucinol and pyrogallol did not show that induction.
facts.source_locator: Methods L923-L955; Results and Figure 6 caption L1800-L1846
facts.conditions: At OD600 0.5, 1 mM aromatic compound for 2 h; RT-PCR with no-RT contamination controls.
facts.qualification: Transcriptional response, not direct allosteric enzyme activation or proof of a direct GalR ligand. Parent 2023 work handles the regulatory mechanism.

facts.claim: Adapted KT2440 grew with 5 mM gallate as sole carbon source; the insertional galA mutant did not and lacked detectable gallate dioxygenase activity in citrate plus gallate.
facts.source_locator: Methods L443-L450 and L888-L921; Results L1848-L1878
facts.conditions: Gallate growth medium included 1 mM L-cysteine to reduce oxidation; parental citrate-plus-gallate extract activity was 1.0 micromol/min/mg.
facts.qualification: The mutant was made by single-crossover insertion of a 0.7-kb internal fragment through pK18mob, not a clean deletion. Do not infer every downstream enzyme or all strain-wide exclusivity from this experiment.

facts.claim: Gallate did not induce the tested pca, pha or hmg genes in the reported RT-PCR experiment.
facts.source_locator: Results, physiology, p.35390; final/rest2 transcript L1880-L1885
facts.qualification: Data not shown; condition-specific negative expression observation, not metabolic impossibility.
